This is a clear sprayed protection film applied to your vehicle which will help protect your paint. The film is full peelable and resistant to fuel and chemicals. There are 2 options available for our paint protection finish.

Option 1: Protection film applied to the entire vehicle

Option 2: Protection film applied to the front for gap forward. This protects the front wings, bonnet and front bumper. These are generally the areas which will receive the most damage on any vehicle.

If you require any specific areas protected, please give us a call for a bespoke quote.

Using paint protection on your car offers several advantages, including:

  1. Protection against Environmental Hazards: Paint protection products create a barrier between your car’s paint and various environmental hazards such as UV rays, bird droppings, tree sap, acid rain, road salt, and pollution. This helps prevent paint damage, fading, and deterioration caused by exposure to these elements.
  2. Prevention of Oxidation and Fading: UV rays from the sun can cause oxidation and fading of your car’s paint over time. Paint protection products, such as ceramic coatings and paint sealants, contain UV inhibitors that shield the paint from harmful sunlight, preserving its color and finish for longer.
  3. Resistance to Scratches and Swirl Marks: Protective coatings like ceramic coatings and paint protection film (PPF) offer a durable layer of protection against scratches, swirl marks, and minor abrasions. They help maintain the integrity of the paint surface and reduce the risk of damage from daily wear and tear, such as washing and detailing.
  4. Ease of Cleaning and Maintenance: Paint protection products create a smooth and hydrophobic surface that repels water, dirt, and contaminants. This makes it easier to clean your car and reduces the frequency of washing. Additionally, protected surfaces are less prone to water spots and stains, resulting in a cleaner and more polished appearance.
  5. Enhanced Gloss and Shine: Many paint protection products enhance the gloss and shine of your car’s paint, giving it a showroom-quality finish. These products create a smooth and reflective surface that enhances the depth and clarity of the paint, making your car look newer and more attractive.
  6. Long-Term Cost Savings: While there is an initial investment in applying paint protection products, they can save you money in the long run by reducing the need for frequent paint correction, repainting, and cosmetic repairs. By preserving the integrity of your car’s paint, paint protection products help maintain its resale value and prolong its lifespan.
  7. Customization and Personalization: Paint protection products come in a variety of formulations, including clear coatings, color-enhancing sealants, and matte finishes. This allows you to customize the appearance of your car and achieve the desired level of protection while reflecting your personal style and preferences.

Overall, using paint protection on your car helps preserve its appearance, protect its resale value, and prolong its lifespan by shielding the paint from environmental damage, scratches, and fading.
